\begin{document}
The escape probability is written with the upper incomplete gamma function $\Gamma(s,x)$, for real $x$ and $s$.
\begin{equation}
\Gamma(1,x) = e^{-x}
\label{eq:ig1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\Gamma(s+1,x) = s\,\Gamma(s,x) + x^{s} e^{-x}
\label{eq:ig2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
